search_window.basis: Since previous verified hourly supplementary Care Line watch heartbeat. Late-indexed developments assessed as recall candidates and excluded when already recorded. Production national collector remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: United States (including DC) and territories: confirmed hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care closures or suspensions, emergency/rural access loss, ambulance/air-medical/base loss, CMS/CLIA notices, and concrete essential-service restoration.

cms_public_notices.note: CMS official listing still begins with the three October 23 HHA terminations already identified: My Families Healthcare (CA 758151), 1ST AIDE HOME HEALTH AGENCY (CA 559673), and Moonlight Home Health Care Inc (OH 369006).

coverage_notes.exclusions: CMS October 23 HHA actions and Doylestown Hospital ER, Dennys River Ambulance and similar cases predate this window and are already recorded. Search results were largely historic, theoretical risk/proposals, unrelated content, or non-US (including Oct 24 Nicola Valley Hospital in Canada).
coverage_notes.findings_explanation: No new qualifying nonduplicate US or territorial healthcare-access change verified in this bounded supplementary recall. Zero results do not imply that no change occurred; indexing and local reporting lag may exist.
coverage_notes.limitations: Targeted search is non-exhaustive and may miss under-indexed local/territorial notices, especially Sunday early morning; no material retrieval failures observed.
coverage_notes.controls: Supplementary recall only; authoritative production collector unchanged. No approvals, publication, schedule changes, or task disabling.
